re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. Outputs Write the standard review artifacts: - `outputs/pr_review.json` — structured data with `recommendation`, `summary`, `inlineComments`, `issueCounts` - `outputs/pr_review_general.md` — 1-2 paragraph general PR comment - `outputs/pr_review_comments/*.md` — one file per detailed inline comment **Inline comment lines must be present in the PR diff.** GitHub review threads can only be attached to added or context lines inside a diff hunk. # gh-967: Remove dmtools executor bash rules from teammate prompts — keep only fa-sandbox-required bash guidance

## Description

## Goal — Teammate prompts carry zero dmtools-executor bash rules (v3.1, frame inverted; owner decisions folded in)

One sentence: **Every teammate-facing prompt (`prompts/*.md`, `instructions/**/*.md` composed via `*.json` cliPrompts) contains no `cli_execute_command` / metacharacter-executor rules at all; the bash guidance that survives is only what the teammate's own fa sandbox demonstrably requires; the executor constraints live in agent-authoring docs.**

## Retractions
- v1–v2 "split the rule block per surface, keep the CLI half in the prompt" — owner correction: the CLI half does not belong in teammate prompts in ANY form. `cli_execute_command` runs only inside dmtools JS actions in this repo (agent authoring), never in the teammate runtime; carrying its rules in prompts burns noise into every session of ~20 agents.
- v2 "add an allowance for chaining on the bash surface" — subsumed: with the executor block deleted, nothing in the prompt forbids chaining anymore; no new allowance text is needed.

## Facts pinned
- **Executor constraint is author-side only**: `cli_execute_command` / CliCommandExecutor rejects `; && || | > <` + substitution; quoting does NOT bypass (guard scans the whole string); compound logic goes through a script file. `js/common/setupCommands.js:24-32`, `js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:142-150`, `AGENTS.md:36` (dmtools global). Used only when writing agents — never by a teammate.

name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Install dmtools CLI
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash
          echo "$HOME/.dmtools/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Run docs unit tests
        run: |
          dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_agentDocsCoverage.json

+## cli_execute_command — author-side executor rules (never teammate-facing)
+
+`cli_execute_command` runs only inside dmtools JS actions in this repo (agent
+authoring) — never in the teammate runtime. Its executor (CliCommandExecutor)
+rejects `;`, `&&`, `||`, `|`, `>`, `<`, and substitution (backticks, `$(...)`,
+`${...}`) anywhere in the command string.
+
+Rules for author-side JS:
+
+- One simple executable command at a time.
+- Quoting does NOT bypass the guard — the scan covers the whole command string.
+- Compound logic goes through a script file: write the script, then run the
+  script as a single command.
+

+the dmtools global Copilot instructions. These rules must NOT be copied into

# gh-967: Remove dmtools executor bash rules from teammate prompts — keep only fa-sandbox-required bash guidance

## Description

## Goal — Teammate prompts carry zero dmtools-executor bash rules (v3.1, frame inverted; owner decisions folded in)

One sentence: **Every teammate-facing prompt (`prompts/*.md`, `instructions/**/*.md` composed via `*.json` cliPrompts) contains no `cli_execute_command` / metacharacter-executor rules at all; the bash guidance that survives is only what the teammate's own fa sandbox demonstrably requires; the executor constraints live in agent-authoring docs.**

## Retractions
- v1–v2 "split the rule block per surface, keep the CLI half in the prompt" — owner correction: the CLI half does not belong in teammate prompts in ANY form. `cli_execute_command` runs only inside dmtools JS actions in this repo (agent authoring), never in the teammate runtime; carrying its rules in prompts burns noise into every session of ~20 agents.
- v2 "add an allowance for chaining on the bash surface" — subsumed: with the executor block deleted, nothing in the prompt forbids chaining anymore; no new allowance text is needed.

## Facts pinned
- **Executor constraint is author-side only**: `cli_execute_command` / CliCommandExecutor rejects `; && || | > <` + substitution; quoting does NOT bypass (guard scans the whole string); compound logic goes through a script file. `js/common/setupCommands.js:24-32`, `js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:142-150`, `AGENTS.md:36` (dmtools global). Used only when writing agents — never by a teammate.
- **Teammate bash = fa-harness persistent shell.** Sandbox-observed errors that justify every surviving rule: trailing `exit` kills the session → `read_bash` fails `Invalid shell ID`; late `$?` reads the wrong command's code; `$PIPESTATUS` produced wrong exit codes; foreground sleep-poll pins the tool-call open (gh-775, B1–B7); cwd carry-over silently writes outputs into `dependencies/<repo>/` (C1–C8).
- **The leak**: `prompts/bash_tools.md:8-24` (SAFETY S1/S2 + FORBIDDEN + EXAMPLES) is pure executor guidance composed into ~20 agent JSONs; `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` is an orphan duplicate (`KNOWN_ORPHANS`, `js/unit-tests/test_instructionRefs.js:36`).
- Author-side docs already exist: `AGENTS.md` (dmtools globals), `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md`.

## Change
1. `prompts/bash_tools.md`: **delete** the SAFETY/FORBIDDEN/EXAMPLES block (lines 8–24). Keep B1–B7, C1–C8, and fold in the three orphan rules (no trailing `exit`, immediate `$?`, no `$PIPESTATUS`) — each justified by a sandbox error above. No dmtools-CLI-execution wording remains.
2. Delete `instructions/common/bash_tools.md`; drop its `KNOWN_ORPHANS` entry.
3. Re-home the executor rules for agent authors — single plain command, script-file wrapper, quoting-no-bypass, scan-whole-string — into `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` (owner-decided home; not `AGENTS.md`).
4. `prompts/story_solution_prompt.md:26` — the `&&` one-liner becomes legal by deletion; keep it, contradiction gone.
5. `instructions/common/dmtools_cli.md` unchanged (teammate invoking dmtools binaries for data is teammate work, not the executor).
6. Regenerate snapshots; update text-asserts; `js/` untouched.

## Acceptance criteria
- **AC1** — no teammate-facing md under `prompts/` or `instructions/` contains executor-rule strings ("metacharacter", `Chaining: ; && ||`, "One simple executable command at a time"). Hook: grep gate + text-assert.
- **AC2** — `prompts/bash_tools.md` keeps the B1–B7 chain verbatim (existing `B1 --> … --> B7` assert in `js/unit-tests/test_developTicketAndCreatePR.js` passes unchanged), keeps C1–C8, and now houses exit/`$?`/`$PIPESTATUS`.
- **AC3** — `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` deleted; `test_instructionRefs.js` green without the orphan entry.
- **AC4** — `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` contains the re-homed executor rules.
- **AC5** — no snapshot contains both a chaining-forbid string and a `&&` example (today `snapshots/story_solution.md:248/333` fails).
- **AC6** — `node generate_agent_snapshots.js` delta removes only the bash-tools FORBIDDEN/EXAMPLES section across snapshots; second run leaves a clean tree.
- **AC7** — `git diff --stat js/` empty for the implementing PR.

## Test plan
- `UT-P1` (AC1): text-assert — executor strings absent from `prompts/` + `instructions/`.
- `UT-P2` (AC2): existing B7 suite green; new asserts for exit/`$?`/`$PIPESTATUS` presence.
- `UT-P3` (AC3): `test_instructionRefs.js` green post-removal.
- `UT-P4` (AC4): SKILL.md contains the re-homed rules.
- `UT-P5` (AC5): snapshot contradiction scan.
- `IT-P1` (AC6): regeneration idempotent; delta scoped to the bash-tools sections.
- `E2E-P1`: one scratch dev-agent job on an `fa` runner — a chained `&&` command executes in the teammate shell; outputs delivery unaffected.
- `REG-P1` (AC2): sandbox rules survive verbatim (exit, `$?`, `$PIPESTATUS`, B1–B7, C1–C8). Merge rule: **red REG blocks merge even with all UT/IT/E2E green.**
- `REG-P2` (AC7): CI diff-guard that `js/` is unchanged.

## Edge cases
- **E1** — if the E2E probe shows the fa sandbox itself rejects some operator, the prompt stays SILENT (owner-decided): the finding is reported back to the owner, not encoded as a teammate prompt rule.
- **E2** — weak model re-added to the provider queue later: nothing to re-tighten prompt-side; iteration cost is governed by model choice, not prompt bans.
- **E3** — ticket-derived text: `sanitizeForShell` / title sanitization stay byte-identical (AC7).
- **E4** — chaining never overrides B1 background-first for long jobs.

## Non-goals
No `js/` or executor-guard changes; no changes to `dmtools_cli.md` data-fetch guidance; no per-agent prompt files; no model/provider names in prompts.

## Decisions (owner, 2026-10-17)
1. Executor-rules home: `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` — confirmed.
2. Probe-discovered operator rejections: the prompt stays silent — no rules added from probe findings.

  "key": "gh-967",
  "fields": {
    "summary": "Remove dmtools executor bash rules from teammate prompts — keep only fa-sandbox-required bash guidance",
    "description": "## Goal — Teammate prompts carry zero dmtools-executor bash rules (v3.1, frame inverted; owner decisions folded in)

One sentence: **Every teammate-facing prompt (`prompts/*.md`, `instructions/**/*.md` composed via `*.json` cliPrompts) contains no `cli_execute_command` / metacharacter-executor rules at all; the bash guidance that survives is only what the teammate's own fa sandbox demonstrably requires; the executor constraints live in agent-authoring docs.**

## Retractions
- v1–v2 "split the rule block per surface, keep the CLI half in the prompt" — owner correction: the CLI half does not belong in teammate prompts in ANY form. `cli_execute_command` runs only inside dmtools JS actions in this repo (agent authoring), never in the teammate runtime; carrying its rules in prompts burns noise into every session of ~20 agents.
- v2 "add an allowance for chaining on the bash surface" — subsumed: with the executor block deleted, nothing in the prompt forbids chaining anymore; no new allowance text is needed.

## Facts pinned
- **Executor constraint is author-side only**: `cli_execute_command` / CliCommandExecutor rejects `; && || | > <` + substitution; quoting does NOT bypass (guard scans the whole string); compound logic goes through a script file. `js/common/setupCommands.js:24-32`, `js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:142-150`, `AGENTS.md:36` (dmtools global). Used only when writing agents — never by a teammate.
- **Teammate bash = fa-harness persistent shell.** Sandbox-observed errors that justify every surviving rule: trailing `exit` kills the session → `read_bash` fails `Invalid shell ID`; late `$?` reads the wrong command's code; `$PIPESTATUS` produced wrong exit codes; foreground sleep-poll pins the tool-call open (gh-775, B1–B7); cwd carry-over silently writes outputs into `dependencies/<repo>/` (C1–C8).
- **The leak**: `prompts/bash_tools.md:8-24` (SAFETY S1/S2 + FORBIDDEN + EXAMPLES) is pure executor guidance composed into ~20 agent JSONs; `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` is an orphan duplicate (`KNOWN_ORPHANS`, `js/unit-tests/test_instructionRefs.js:36`).
- Author-side docs already exist: `AGENTS.md` (dmtools globals), `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md`.

## Change
1. `prompts/bash_tools.md`: **delete** the SAFETY/FORBIDDEN/EXAMPLES block (lines 8–24). Keep B1–B7, C1–C8, and fold in the three orphan rules (no trailing `exit`, immediate `$?`, no `$PIPESTATUS`) — each justified by a sandbox error above. No dmtools-CLI-execution wording remains.
2. Delete `instructions/common/bash_tools.md`; drop its `KNOWN_ORPHANS` entry.
3. Re-home the executor rules for agent authors — single plain command, script-file wrapper, quoting-no-bypass, scan-whole-string — into `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` (owner-decided home; not `AGENTS.md`).
4. `prompts/story_solution_prompt.md:26` — the `&&` one-liner becomes legal by deletion; keep it, contradiction gone.
5. `instructions/common/dmtools_cli.md` unchanged (teammate invoking dmtools binaries for data is teammate work, not the executor).
6. Regenerate snapshots; update text-asserts; `js/` untouched.

## Acceptance criteria
- **AC1** — no teammate-facing md under `prompts/` or `instructions/` contains executor-rule strings ("metacharacter", `Chaining: ; && ||`, "One simple executable command at a time"). Hook: grep gate + text-assert.
- **AC2** — `prompts/bash_tools.md` keeps the B1–B7 chain verbatim (existing `B1 --> … --> B7` assert in `js/unit-tests/test_developTicketAndCreatePR.js` passes unchanged), keeps C1–C8, and now houses exit/`$?`/`$PIPESTATUS`.
- **AC3** — `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` deleted; `test_instructionRefs.js` green without the orphan entry.
- **AC4** — `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` contains the re-homed executor rules.
- **AC5** — no snapshot contains both a chaining-forbid string and a `&&` example (today `snapshots/story_solution.md:248/333` fails).
- **AC6** — `node generate_agent_snapshots.js` delta removes only the bash-tools FORBIDDEN/EXAMPLES section across snapshots; second run leaves a clean tree.
- **AC7** — `git diff --stat js/` empty for the implementing PR.

## Test plan
- `UT-P1` (AC1): text-assert — executor strings absent from `prompts/` + `instructions/`.
- `UT-P2` (AC2): existing B7 suite green; new asserts for exit/`$?`/`$PIPESTATUS` presence.
- `UT-P3` (AC3): `test_instructionRefs.js` green post-removal.
- `UT-P4` (AC4): SKILL.md contains the re-homed rules.
- `UT-P5` (AC5): snapshot contradiction scan.
- `IT-P1` (AC6): regeneration idempotent; delta scoped to the bash-tools sections.
- `E2E-P1`: one scratch dev-agent job on an `fa` runner — a chained `&&` command executes in the teammate shell; outputs delivery unaffected.
- `REG-P1` (AC2): sandbox rules survive verbatim (exit, `$?`, `$PIPESTATUS`, B1–B7, C1–C8). Merge rule: **red REG blocks merge even with all UT/IT/E2E green.**
- `REG-P2` (AC7): CI diff-guard that `js/` is unchanged.

## Edge cases
- **E1** — if the E2E probe shows the fa sandbox itself rejects some operator, the prompt stays SILENT (owner-decided): the finding is reported back to the owner, not encoded as a teammate prompt rule.
- **E2** — weak model re-added to the provider queue later: nothing to re-tighten prompt-side; iteration cost is governed by model choice, not prompt bans.
- **E3** — ticket-derived text: `sanitizeForShell` / title sanitization stay byte-identical (AC7).
- **E4** — chaining never overrides B1 background-first for long jobs.

## Non-goals
No `js/` or executor-guard changes; no changes to `dmtools_cli.md` data-fetch guidance; no per-agent prompt files; no model/provider names in prompts.

## Decisions (owner, 2026-10-17)
1. Executor-rules home: `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` — confirmed.
2. Probe-discovered operator rejections: the prompt stays silent — no rules added from probe findings.

blocks.text:
name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Install dmtools CLI
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash
          echo "$HOME/.dmtools/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Run docs unit tests
        run: |
          dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_agentDocsCoverage.json

blocks.text:
# gh-967: Remove dmtools executor bash rules from teammate prompts — keep only fa-sandbox-required bash guidance

## Description

## Goal — Teammate prompts carry zero dmtools-executor bash rules (v3.1, frame inverted; owner decisions folded in)

One sentence: **Every teammate-facing prompt (`prompts/*.md`, `instructions/**/*.md` composed via `*.json` cliPrompts) contains no `cli_execute_command` / metacharacter-executor rules at all; the bash guidance that survives is only what the teammate's own fa sandbox demonstrably requires; the executor constraints live in agent-authoring docs.**

## Retractions
- v1–v2 "split the rule block per surface, keep the CLI half in the prompt" — owner correction: the CLI half does not belong in teammate prompts in ANY form. `cli_execute_command` runs only inside dmtools JS actions in this repo (agent authoring), never in the teammate runtime; carrying its rules in prompts burns noise into every session of ~20 agents.
- v2 "add an allowance for chaining on the bash surface" — subsumed: with the executor block deleted, nothing in the prompt forbids chaining anymore; no new allowance text is needed.

## Facts pinned
- **Executor constraint is author-side only**: `cli_execute_command` / CliCommandExecutor rejects `; && || | > <` + substitution; quoting does NOT bypass (guard scans the whole string); compound logic goes through a script file. `js/common/setupCommands.js:24-32`, `js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:142-150`, `AGENTS.md:36` (dmtools global). Used only when writing agents — never by a teammate.
- **Teammate bash = fa-harness persistent shell.** Sandbox-observed errors that justify every surviving rule: trailing `exit` kills the session → `read_bash` fails `Invalid shell ID`; late `$?` reads the wrong command's code; `$PIPESTATUS` produced wrong exit codes; foreground sleep-poll pins the tool-call open (gh-775, B1–B7); cwd carry-over silently writes outputs into `dependencies/<repo>/` (C1–C8).
- **The leak**: `prompts/bash_tools.md:8-24` (SAFETY S1/S2 + FORBIDDEN + EXAMPLES) is pure executor guidance composed into ~20 agent JSONs; `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` is an orphan duplicate (`KNOWN_ORPHANS`, `js/unit-tests/test_instructionRefs.js:36`).
- Author-side docs already exist: `AGENTS.md` (dmtools globals), `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md`.

## Change
1. `prompts/bash_tools.md`: **delete** the SAFETY/FORBIDDEN/EXAMPLES block (lines 8–24). Keep B1–B7, C1–C8, and fold in the three orphan rules (no trailing `exit`, immediate `$?`, no `$PIPESTATUS`) — each justified by a sandbox error above. No dmtools-CLI-execution wording remains.
2. Delete `instructions/common/bash_tools.md`; drop its `KNOWN_ORPHANS` entry.
3. Re-home the executor rules for agent authors — single plain command, script-file wrapper, quoting-no-bypass, scan-whole-string — into `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` (owner-decided home; not `AGENTS.md`).
4. `prompts/story_solution_prompt.md:26` — the `&&` one-liner becomes legal by deletion; keep it, contradiction gone.
5. `instructions/common/dmtools_cli.md` unchanged (teammate invoking dmtools binaries for data is teammate work, not the executor).
6. Regenerate snapshots; update text-asserts; `js/` untouched.

## Acceptance criteria
- **AC1** — no teammate-facing md under `prompts/` or `instructions/` contains executor-rule strings ("metacharacter", `Chaining: ; && ||`, "One simple executable command at a time"). Hook: grep gate + text-assert.
- **AC2** — `prompts/bash_tools.md` keeps the B1–B7 chain verbatim (existing `B1 --> … --> B7` assert in `js/unit-tests/test_developTicketAndCreatePR.js` passes unchanged), keeps C1–C8, and now houses exit/`$?`/`$PIPESTATUS`.
- **AC3** — `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` deleted; `test_instructionRefs.js` green without the orphan entry.
- **AC4** — `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` contains the re-homed executor rules.
- **AC5** — no snapshot contains both a chaining-forbid string and a `&&` example (today `snapshots/story_solution.md:248/333` fails).
- **AC6** — `node generate_agent_snapshots.js` delta removes only the bash-tools FORBIDDEN/EXAMPLES section across snapshots; second run leaves a clean tree.
- **AC7** — `git diff --stat js/` empty for the implementing PR.

## Test plan
- `UT-P1` (AC1): text-assert — executor strings absent from `prompts/` + `instructions/`.
- `UT-P2` (AC2): existing B7 suite green; new asserts for exit/`$?`/`$PIPESTATUS` presence.
- `UT-P3` (AC3): `test_instructionRefs.js` green post-removal.
- `UT-P4` (AC4): SKILL.md contains the re-homed rules.
- `UT-P5` (AC5): snapshot contradiction scan.
- `IT-P1` (AC6): regeneration idempotent; delta scoped to the bash-tools sections.
- `E2E-P1`: one scratch dev-agent job on an `fa` runner — a chained `&&` command executes in the teammate shell; outputs delivery unaffected.
- `REG-P1` (AC2): sandbox rules survive verbatim (exit, `$?`, `$PIPESTATUS`, B1–B7, C1–C8). Merge rule: **red REG blocks merge even with all UT/IT/E2E green.**
- `REG-P2` (AC7): CI diff-guard that `js/` is unchanged.

## Edge cases
- **E1** — if the E2E probe shows the fa sandbox itself rejects some operator, the prompt stays SILENT (owner-decided): the finding is reported back to the owner, not encoded as a teammate prompt rule.
- **E2** — weak model re-added to the provider queue later: nothing to re-tighten prompt-side; iteration cost is governed by model choice, not prompt bans.
- **E3** — ticket-derived text: `sanitizeForShell` / title sanitization stay byte-identical (AC7).
- **E4** — chaining never overrides B1 background-first for long jobs.

## Non-goals
No `js/` or executor-guard changes; no changes to `dmtools_cli.md` data-fetch guidance; no per-agent prompt files; no model/provider names in prompts.

## Decisions (owner, 2026-10-17)
1. Executor-rules home: `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` — confirmed.
2. Probe-discovered operator rejections: the prompt stays silent — no rules added from probe findings.

## References
- `prompts/bash_tools.md:8-24` (block to delete); B1–B7 / C1–C8 (to keep)
- `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` + `js/unit-tests/test_instructionRefs.js:36`
- `js/common/setupCommands.js:24-32`; `js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:142-150`; `AGENTS.md:36`
- `prompts/story_solution_prompt.md:26`; `snapshots/story_solution.md:248/333`
- `generate_agent_snapshots.js`; `.dmtools/runners/fa-*.json`
- `js/unit-tests/test_developTicketAndCreatePR.js` (`prompts/bash_tools.md > B7` suite, gh-775)

## Machine jobs
- [x] ▶ dev (fa-story-dev) · [run](https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/actions/runs/39033733321) · started 12:46 · done 13:14 ✅

    "description": "## Goal — Teammate prompts carry zero dmtools-executor bash rules (v3.1, frame inverted; owner decisions folded in)

One sentence: **Every teammate-facing prompt (`prompts/*.md`, `instructions/**/*.md` composed via `*.json` cliPrompts) contains no `cli_execute_command` / metacharacter-executor rules at all; the bash guidance that survives is only what the teammate's own fa sandbox demonstrably requires; the executor constraints live in agent-authoring docs.**

## Retractions
- v1–v2 "split the rule block per surface, keep the CLI half in the prompt" — owner correction: the CLI half does not belong in teammate prompts in ANY form. `cli_execute_command` runs only inside dmtools JS actions in this repo (agent authoring), never in the teammate runtime; carrying its rules in prompts burns noise into every session of ~20 agents.
- v2 "add an allowance for chaining on the bash surface" — subsumed: with the executor block deleted, nothing in the prompt forbids chaining anymore; no new allowance text is needed.

## Facts pinned
- **Executor constraint is author-side only**: `cli_execute_command` / CliCommandExecutor rejects `; && || | > <` + substitution; quoting does NOT bypass (guard scans the whole string); compound logic goes through a script file. `js/common/setupCommands.js:24-32`, `js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:142-150`, `AGENTS.md:36` (dmtools global). Used only when writing agents — never by a teammate.
- **Teammate bash = fa-harness persistent shell.** Sandbox-observed errors that justify every surviving rule: trailing `exit` kills the session → `read_bash` fails `Invalid shell ID`; late `$?` reads the wrong command's code; `$PIPESTATUS` produced wrong exit codes; foreground sleep-poll pins the tool-call open (gh-775, B1–B7); cwd carry-over silently writes outputs into `dependencies/<repo>/` (C1–C8).
- **The leak**: `prompts/bash_tools.md:8-24` (SAFETY S1/S2 + FORBIDDEN + EXAMPLES) is pure executor guidance composed into ~20 agent JSONs; `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` is an orphan duplicate (`KNOWN_ORPHANS`, `js/unit-tests/test_instructionRefs.js:36`).
- Author-side docs already exist: `AGENTS.md` (dmtools globals), `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md`.

## Change
1. `prompts/bash_tools.md`: **delete** the SAFETY/FORBIDDEN/EXAMPLES block (lines 8–24). Keep B1–B7, C1–C8, and fold in the three orphan rules (no trailing `exit`, immediate `$?`, no `$PIPESTATUS`) — each justified by a sandbox error above. No dmtools-CLI-execution wording remains.
2. Delete `instructions/common/bash_tools.md`; drop its `KNOWN_ORPHANS` entry.
3. Re-home the executor rules for agent authors — single plain command, script-file wrapper, quoting-no-bypass, scan-whole-string — into `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` (owner-decided home; not `AGENTS.md`).
4. `prompts/story_solution_prompt.md:26` — the `&&` one-liner becomes legal by deletion; keep it, contradiction gone.
5. `instructions/common/dmtools_cli.md` unchanged (teammate invoking dmtools binaries for data is teammate work, not the executor).
6. Regenerate snapshots; update text-asserts; `js/` untouched.

## Acceptance criteria
- **AC1** — no teammate-facing md under `prompts/` or `instructions/` contains executor-rule strings ("metacharacter", `Chaining: ; && ||`, "One simple executable command at a time"). Hook: grep gate + text-assert.
- **AC2** — `prompts/bash_tools.md` keeps the B1–B7 chain verbatim (existing `B1 --> … --> B7` assert in `js/unit-tests/test_developTicketAndCreatePR.js` passes unchanged), keeps C1–C8, and now houses exit/`$?`/`$PIPESTATUS`.
- **AC3** — `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` deleted; `test_instructionRefs.js` green without the orphan entry.
- **AC4** — `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` contains the re-homed executor rules.
- **AC5** — no snapshot contains both a chaining-forbid string and a `&&` example (today `snapshots/story_solution.md:248/333` fails).
- **AC6** — `node generate_agent_snapshots.js` delta removes only the bash-tools FORBIDDEN/EXAMPLES section across snapshots; second run leaves a clean tree.
- **AC7** — `git diff --stat js/` empty for the implementing PR.

## Test plan
- `UT-P1` (AC1): text-assert — executor strings absent from `prompts/` + `instructions/`.
- `UT-P2` (AC2): existing B7 suite green; new asserts for exit/`$?`/`$PIPESTATUS` presence.
- `UT-P3` (AC3): `test_instructionRefs.js` green post-removal.
- `UT-P4` (AC4): SKILL.md contains the re-homed rules.
- `UT-P5` (AC5): snapshot contradiction scan.
- `IT-P1` (AC6): regeneration idempotent; delta scoped to the bash-tools sections.
- `E2E-P1`: one scratch dev-agent job on an `fa` runner — a chained `&&` command executes in the teammate shell; outputs delivery unaffected.
- `REG-P1` (AC2): sandbox rules survive verbatim (exit, `$?`, `$PIPESTATUS`, B1–B7, C1–C8). Merge rule: **red REG blocks merge even with all UT/IT/E2E green.**
- `REG-P2` (AC7): CI diff-guard that `js/` is unchanged.

## Edge cases
- **E1** — if the E2E probe shows the fa sandbox itself rejects some operator, the prompt stays SILENT (owner-decided): the finding is reported back to the owner, not encoded as a teammate prompt rule.
- **E2** — weak model re-added to the provider queue later: nothing to re-tighten prompt-side; iteration cost is governed by model choice, not prompt bans.
- **E3** — ticket-derived text: `sanitizeForShell` / title sanitization stay byte-identical (AC7).
- **E4** — chaining never overrides B1 background-first for long jobs.

## Non-goals
No `js/` or executor-guard changes; no changes to `dmtools_cli.md` data-fetch guidance; no per-agent prompt files; no model/provider names in prompts.

name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Install dmtools CLI
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash
          echo "$HOME/.dmtools/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Run docs unit tests
        run: |
          dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_agentDocsCoverage.json

blocks.text:
# gh-967: Remove dmtools executor bash rules from teammate prompts — keep only fa-sandbox-required bash guidance

## Description

## Goal — Teammate prompts carry zero dmtools-executor bash rules (v3.1, frame inverted; owner decisions folded in)

One sentence: **Every teammate-facing prompt (`prompts/*.md`, `instructions/**/*.md` composed via `*.json` cliPrompts) contains no `cli_execute_command` / metacharacter-executor rules at all; the bash guidance that survives is only what the teammate's own fa sandbox demonstrably requires; the executor constraints live in agent-authoring docs.**

## Retractions
- v1–v2 "split the rule block per surface, keep the CLI half in the prompt" — owner correction: the CLI half does not belong in teammate prompts in ANY form. `cli_execute_command` runs only inside dmtools JS actions in this repo (agent authoring), never in the teammate runtime; carrying its rules in prompts burns noise into every session of ~20 agents.
- v2 "add an allowance for chaining on the bash surface" — subsumed: with the executor block deleted, nothing in the prompt forbids chaining anymore; no new allowance text is needed.

## Facts pinned
- **Executor constraint is author-side only**: `cli_execute_command` / CliCommandExecutor rejects `; && || | > <` + substitution; quoting does NOT bypass (guard scans the whole string); compound logic goes through a script file. `js/common/setupCommands.js:24-32`, `js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:142-150`, `AGENTS.md:36` (dmtools global). Used only when writing agents — never by a teammate.
- **Teammate bash = fa-harness persistent shell.** Sandbox-observed errors that justify every surviving rule: trailing `exit` kills the session → `read_bash` fails `Invalid shell ID`; late `$?` reads the wrong command's code; `$PIPESTATUS` produced wrong exit codes; foreground sleep-poll pins the tool-call open (gh-775, B1–B7); cwd carry-over silently writes outputs into `dependencies/<repo>/` (C1–C8).
- **The leak**: `prompts/bash_tools.md:8-24` (SAFETY S1/S2 + FORBIDDEN + EXAMPLES) is pure executor guidance composed into ~20 agent JSONs; `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` is an orphan duplicate (`KNOWN_ORPHANS`, `js/unit-tests/test_instructionRefs.js:36`).
- Author-side docs already exist: `AGENTS.md` (dmtools globals), `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md`.

## Change
1. `prompts/bash_tools.md`: **delete** the SAFETY/FORBIDDEN/EXAMPLES block (lines 8–24). Keep B1–B7, C1–C8, and fold in the three orphan rules (no trailing `exit`, immediate `$?`, no `$PIPESTATUS`) — each justified by a sandbox error above. No dmtools-CLI-execution wording remains.
2. Delete `instructions/common/bash_tools.md`; drop its `KNOWN_ORPHANS` entry.
3. Re-home the executor rules for agent authors — single plain command, script-file wrapper, quoting-no-bypass, scan-whole-string — into `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` (owner-decided home; not `AGENTS.md`).
4. `prompts/story_solution_prompt.md:26` — the `&&` one-liner becomes legal by deletion; keep it, contradiction gone.
5. `instructions/common/dmtools_cli.md` unchanged (teammate invoking dmtools binaries for data is teammate work, not the executor).
6. Regenerate snapshots; update text-asserts; `js/` untouched.

## Acceptance criteria
- **AC1** — no teammate-facing md under `prompts/` or `instructions/` contains executor-rule strings ("metacharacter", `Chaining: ; && ||`, "One simple executable command at a time"). Hook: grep gate + text-assert.
- **AC2** — `prompts/bash_tools.md` keeps the B1–B7 chain verbatim (existing `B1 --> … --> B7` assert in `js/unit-tests/test_developTicketAndCreatePR.js` passes unchanged), keeps C1–C8, and now houses exit/`$?`/`$PIPESTATUS`.
- **AC3** — `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` deleted; `test_instructionRefs.js` green without the orphan entry.
- **AC4** — `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` contains the re-homed executor rules.
- **AC5** — no snapshot contains both a chaining-forbid string and a `&&` example (today `snapshots/story_solution.md:248/333` fails).
- **AC6** — `node generate_agent_snapshots.js` delta removes only the bash-tools FORBIDDEN/EXAMPLES section across snapshots; second run leaves a clean tree.
- **AC7** — `git diff --stat js/` empty for the implementing PR.

## Test plan
- `UT-P1` (AC1): text-assert — executor strings absent from `prompts/` + `instructions/`.
- `UT-P2` (AC2): existing B7 suite green; new asserts for exit/`$?`/`$PIPESTATUS` presence.
- `UT-P3` (AC3): `test_instructionRefs.js` green post-removal.
- `UT-P4` (AC4): SKILL.md contains the re-homed rules.
- `UT-P5` (AC5): snapshot contradiction scan.
- `IT-P1` (AC6): regeneration idempotent; delta scoped to the bash-tools sections.
- `E2E-P1`: one scratch dev-agent job on an `fa` runner — a chained `&&` command executes in the teammate shell; outputs delivery unaffected.
- `REG-P1` (AC2): sandbox rules survive verbatim (exit, `$?`, `$PIPESTATUS`, B1–B7, C1–C8). Merge rule: **red REG blocks merge even with all UT/IT/E2E green.**
- `REG-P2` (AC7): CI diff-guard that `js/` is unchanged.

## Edge cases
- **E1** — if the E2E probe shows the fa sandbox itself rejects some operator, the prompt stays SILENT (owner-decided): the finding is reported back to the owner, not encoded as a teammate prompt rule.
- **E2** — weak model re-added to the provider queue later: nothing to re-tighten prompt-side; iteration cost is governed by model choice, not prompt bans.
- **E3** — ticket-derived text: `sanitizeForShell` / title sanitization stay byte-identical (AC7).
- **E4** — chaining never overrides B1 background-first for long jobs.

## Non-goals
No `js/` or executor-guard changes; no changes to `dmtools_cli.md` data-fetch guidance; no per-agent prompt files; no model/provider names in prompts.

## Decisions (owner, 2026-10-17)
1. Executor-rules home: `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` — confirmed.
2. Probe-discovered operator rejections: the prompt stays silent — no rules added from probe findings.

## References
- `prompts/bash_tools.md:8-24` (block to delete); B1–B7 / C1–C8 (to keep)
- `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` + `js/unit-tests/test_instructionRefs.js:36`
- `js/common/setupCommands.js:24-32`; `js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:142-150`; `AGENTS.md:36`
- `prompts/story_solution_prompt.md:26`; `snapshots/story_solution.md:248/333`
- `generate_agent_snapshots.js`; `.dmtools/runners/fa-*.json`
- `js/unit-tests/test_developTicketAndCreatePR.js` (`prompts/bash_tools.md > B7` suite, gh-775)

## Machine jobs
- [x] ▶ dev (fa-story-dev) · [run](https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/actions/runs/39033733321) · started 12:46 · done 13:14 ✅

name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Install dmtools CLI
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash
          echo "$HOME/.dmtools/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Run docs unit tests
        run: |
          dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_agentDocsCoverage.json

# gh-967: Remove dmtools executor bash rules from teammate prompts — keep only fa-sandbox-required bash guidance

## Description

## Goal — Teammate prompts carry zero dmtools-executor bash rules (v3.1, frame inverted; owner decisions folded in)

One sentence: **Every teammate-facing prompt (`prompts/*.md`, `instructions/**/*.md` composed via `*.json` cliPrompts) contains no `cli_execute_command` / metacharacter-executor rules at all; the bash guidance that survives is only what the teammate's own fa sandbox demonstrably requires; the executor constraints live in agent-authoring docs.**

## Retractions
- v1–v2 "split the rule block per surface, keep the CLI half in the prompt" — owner correction: the CLI half does not belong in teammate prompts in ANY form. `cli_execute_command` runs only inside dmtools JS actions in this repo (agent authoring), never in the teammate runtime; carrying its rules in prompts burns noise into every session of ~20 agents.
- v2 "add an allowance for chaining on the bash surface" — subsumed: with the executor block deleted, nothing in the prompt forbids chaining anymore; no new allowance text is needed.

## Facts pinned
- **Executor constraint is author-side only**: `cli_execute_command` / CliCommandExecutor rejects `; && || | > <` + substitution; quoting does NOT bypass (guard scans the whole string); compound logic goes through a script file. `js/common/setupCommands.js:24-32`, `js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:142-150`, `AGENTS.md:36` (dmtools global). Used only when writing agents — never by a teammate.
- **Teammate bash = fa-harness persistent shell.** Sandbox-observed errors that justify every surviving rule: trailing `exit` kills the session → `read_bash` fails `Invalid shell ID`; late `$?` reads the wrong command's code; `$PIPESTATUS` produced wrong exit codes; foreground sleep-poll pins the tool-call open (gh-775, B1–B7); cwd carry-over silently writes outputs into `dependencies/<repo>/` (C1–C8).
- **The leak**: `prompts/bash_tools.md:8-24` (SAFETY S1/S2 + FORBIDDEN + EXAMPLES) is pure executor guidance composed into ~20 agent JSONs; `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` is an orphan duplicate (`KNOWN_ORPHANS`, `js/unit-tests/test_instructionRefs.js:36`).
- Author-side docs already exist: `AGENTS.md` (dmtools globals), `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md`.

## Change
1. `prompts/bash_tools.md`: **delete** the SAFETY/FORBIDDEN/EXAMPLES block (lines 8–24). Keep B1–B7, C1–C8, and fold in the three orphan rules (no trailing `exit`, immediate `$?`, no `$PIPESTATUS`) — each justified by a sandbox error above. No dmtools-CLI-execution wording remains.
2. Delete `instructions/common/bash_tools.md`; drop its `KNOWN_ORPHANS` entry.
3. Re-home the executor rules for agent authors — single plain command, script-file wrapper, quoting-no-bypass, scan-whole-string — into `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` (owner-decided home; not `AGENTS.md`).
4. `prompts/story_solution_prompt.md:26` — the `&&` one-liner becomes legal by deletion; keep it, contradiction gone.
5. `instructions/common/dmtools_cli.md` unchanged (teammate invoking dmtools binaries for data is teammate work, not the executor).
6. Regenerate snapshots; update text-asserts; `js/` untouched.

## Acceptance criteria
- **AC1** — no teammate-facing md under `prompts/` or `instructions/` contains executor-rule strings ("metacharacter", `Chaining: ; && ||`, "One simple executable command at a time"). Hook: grep gate + text-assert.
- **AC2** — `prompts/bash_tools.md` keeps the B1–B7 chain verbatim (existing `B1 --> … --> B7` assert in `js/unit-tests/test_developTicketAndCreatePR.js` passes unchanged), keeps C1–C8, and now houses exit/`$?`/`$PIPESTATUS`.
- **AC3** — `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` deleted; `test_instructionRefs.js` green without the orphan entry.
- **AC4** — `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` contains the re-homed executor rules.
- **AC5** — no snapshot contains both a chaining-forbid string and a `&&` example (today `snapshots/story_solution.md:248/333` fails).
- **AC6** — `node generate_agent_snapshots.js` delta removes only the bash-tools FORBIDDEN/EXAMPLES section across snapshots; second run leaves a clean tree.
- **AC7** — `git diff --stat js/` empty for the implementing PR.

## Test plan
- `UT-P1` (AC1): text-assert — executor strings absent from `prompts/` + `instructions/`.
- `UT-P2` (AC2): existing B7 suite green; new asserts for exit/`$?`/`$PIPESTATUS` presence.
- `UT-P3` (AC3): `test_instructionRefs.js` green post-removal.
- `UT-P4` (AC4): SKILL.md contains the re-homed rules.
- `UT-P5` (AC5): snapshot contradiction scan.
- `IT-P1` (AC6): regeneration idempotent; delta scoped to the bash-tools sections.
- `E2E-P1`: one scratch dev-agent job on an `fa` runner — a chained `&&` command executes in the teammate shell; outputs delivery unaffected.
- `REG-P1` (AC2): sandbox rules survive verbatim (exit, `$?`, `$PIPESTATUS`, B1–B7, C1–C8). Merge rule: **red REG blocks merge even with all UT/IT/E2E green.**
- `REG-P2` (AC7): CI diff-guard that `js/` is unchanged.

## Edge cases
- **E1** — if the E2E probe shows the fa sandbox itself rejects some operator, the prompt stays SILENT (owner-decided): the finding is reported back to the owner, not encoded as a teammate prompt rule.
- **E2** — weak model re-added to the provider queue later: nothing to re-tighten prompt-side; iteration cost is governed by model choice, not prompt bans.
- **E3** — ticket-derived text: `sanitizeForShell` / title sanitization stay byte-identical (AC7).
- **E4** — chaining never overrides B1 background-first for long jobs.

## Non-goals
No `js/` or executor-guard changes; no changes to `dmtools_cli.md` data-fetch guidance; no per-agent prompt files; no model/provider names in prompts.

## Decisions (owner, 2026-10-17)
1. Executor-rules home: `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` — confirmed.
2. Probe-discovered operator rejections: the prompt stays silent — no rules added from probe findings.

## References
- `prompts/bash_tools.md:8-24` (block to delete); B1–B7 / C1–C8 (to keep)
- `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` + `js/unit-tests/test_instructionRefs.js:36`
- `js/common/setupCommands.js:24-32`; `js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:142-150`; `AGENTS.md:36`
- `prompts/story_solution_prompt.md:26`; `snapshots/story_solution.md:248/333`
- `generate_agent_snapshots.js`; `.dmtools/runners/fa-*.json`
- `js/unit-tests/test_developTicketAndCreatePR.js` (`prompts/bash_tools.md > B7` suite, gh-775)

## Machine jobs
- [x] ▶ dev (fa-story-dev) · [run](https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/actions/runs/39033733321) · started 12:46 · done 13:14 ✅

name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Install dmtools CLI
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash
          echo "$HOME/.dmtools/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Run docs unit tests
        run: |
          dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_agentDocsCoverage.json

+## cli_execute_command — author-side executor rules (never teammate-facing)
+

+Rules for author-side JS:

+- Compound logic goes through a script file: write the script, then run the

+the dmtools global Copilot instructions. These rules must NOT be copied into

# gh-967: Remove dmtools executor bash rules from teammate prompts — keep only fa-sandbox-required bash guidance

## Description

## Goal — Teammate prompts carry zero dmtools-executor bash rules (v3.1, frame inverted; owner decisions folded in)

One sentence: **Every teammate-facing prompt (`prompts/*.md`, `instructions/**/*.md` composed via `*.json` cliPrompts) contains no `cli_execute_command` / metacharacter-executor rules at all; the bash guidance that survives is only what the teammate's own fa sandbox demonstrably requires; the executor constraints live in agent-authoring docs.**

## Retractions
- v1–v2 "split the rule block per surface, keep the CLI half in the prompt" — owner correction: the CLI half does not belong in teammate prompts in ANY form. `cli_execute_command` runs only inside dmtools JS actions in this repo (agent authoring), never in the teammate runtime; carrying its rules in prompts burns noise into every session of ~20 agents.
- v2 "add an allowance for chaining on the bash surface" — subsumed: with the executor block deleted, nothing in the prompt forbids chaining anymore; no new allowance text is needed.

## Facts pinned
- **Executor constraint is author-side only**: `cli_execute_command` / CliCommandExecutor rejects `; && || | > <` + substitution; quoting does NOT bypass (guard scans the whole string); compound logic goes through a script file. `js/common/setupCommands.js:24-32`, `js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:142-150`, `AGENTS.md:36` (dmtools global). Used only when writing agents — never by a teammate.
- **Teammate bash = fa-harness persistent shell.** Sandbox-observed errors that justify every surviving rule: trailing `exit` kills the session → `read_bash` fails `Invalid shell ID`; late `$?` reads the wrong command's code; `$PIPESTATUS` produced wrong exit codes; foreground sleep-poll pins the tool-call open (gh-775, B1–B7); cwd carry-over silently writes outputs into `dependencies/<repo>/` (C1–C8).
- **The leak**: `prompts/bash_tools.md:8-24` (SAFETY S1/S2 + FORBIDDEN + EXAMPLES) is pure executor guidance composed into ~20 agent JSONs; `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` is an orphan duplicate (`KNOWN_ORPHANS`, `js/unit-tests/test_instructionRefs.js:36`).
- Author-side docs already exist: `AGENTS.md` (dmtools globals), `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md`.

## Change
1. `prompts/bash_tools.md`: **delete** the SAFETY/FORBIDDEN/EXAMPLES block (lines 8–24). Keep B1–B7, C1–C8, and fold in the three orphan rules (no trailing `exit`, immediate `$?`, no `$PIPESTATUS`) — each justified by a sandbox error above. No dmtools-CLI-execution wording remains.
2. Delete `instructions/common/bash_tools.md`; drop its `KNOWN_ORPHANS` entry.
3. Re-home the executor rules for agent authors — single plain command, script-file wrapper, quoting-no-bypass, scan-whole-string — into `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` (owner-decided home; not `AGENTS.md`).
4. `prompts/story_solution_prompt.md:26` — the `&&` one-liner becomes legal by deletion; keep it, contradiction gone.
5. `instructions/common/dmtools_cli.md` unchanged (teammate invoking dmtools binaries for data is teammate work, not the executor).
6. Regenerate snapshots; update text-asserts; `js/` untouched.

## Acceptance criteria
- **AC1** — no teammate-facing md under `prompts/` or `instructions/` contains executor-rule strings ("metacharacter", `Chaining: ; && ||`, "One simple executable command at a time"). Hook: grep gate + text-assert.
- **AC2** — `prompts/bash_tools.md` keeps the B1–B7 chain verbatim (existing `B1 --> … --> B7` assert in `js/unit-tests/test_developTicketAndCreatePR.js` passes unchanged), keeps C1–C8, and now houses exit/`$?`/`$PIPESTATUS`.
- **AC3** — `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` deleted; `test_instructionRefs.js` green without the orphan entry.
- **AC4** — `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` contains the re-homed executor rules.
- **AC5** — no snapshot contains both a chaining-forbid string and a `&&` example (today `snapshots/story_solution.md:248/333` fails).
- **AC6** — `node generate_agent_snapshots.js` delta removes only the bash-tools FORBIDDEN/EXAMPLES section across snapshots; second run leaves a clean tree.
- **AC7** — `git diff --stat js/` empty for the implementing PR.

## Test plan
- `UT-P1` (AC1): text-assert — executor strings absent from `prompts/` + `instructions/`.
- `UT-P2` (AC2): existing B7 suite green; new asserts for exit/`$?`/`$PIPESTATUS` presence.
- `UT-P3` (AC3): `test_instructionRefs.js` green post-removal.
- `UT-P4` (AC4): SKILL.md contains the re-homed rules.
- `UT-P5` (AC5): snapshot contradiction scan.
- `IT-P1` (AC6): regeneration idempotent; delta scoped to the bash-tools sections.
- `E2E-P1`: one scratch dev-agent job on an `fa` runner — a chained `&&` command executes in the teammate shell; outputs delivery unaffected.
- `REG-P1` (AC2): sandbox rules survive verbatim (exit, `$?`, `$PIPESTATUS`, B1–B7, C1–C8). Merge rule: **red REG blocks merge even with all UT/IT/E2E green.**
- `REG-P2` (AC7): CI diff-guard that `js/` is unchanged.

## Edge cases
- **E1** — if the E2E probe shows the fa sandbox itself rejects some operator, the prompt stays SILENT (owner-decided): the finding is reported back to the owner, not encoded as a teammate prompt rule.
- **E2** — weak model re-added to the provider queue later: nothing to re-tighten prompt-side; iteration cost is governed by model choice, not prompt bans.
- **E3** — ticket-derived text: `sanitizeForShell` / title sanitization stay byte-identical (AC7).
- **E4** — chaining never overrides B1 background-first for long jobs.

## Non-goals
No `js/` or executor-guard changes; no changes to `dmtools_cli.md` data-fetch guidance; no per-agent prompt files; no model/provider names in prompts.

## Decisions (owner, 2026-10-17)
1. Executor-rules home: `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` — confirmed.
2. Probe-discovered operator rejections: the prompt stays silent — no rules added from probe findings.

## References
- `prompts/bash_tools.md:8-24` (block to delete); B1–B7 / C1–C8 (to keep)
- `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` + `js/unit-tests/test_instructionRefs.js:36`
- `js/common/setupCommands.js:24-32`; `js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:142-150`; `AGENTS.md:36`
- `prompts/story_solution_prompt.md:26`; `snapshots/story_solution.md:248/333`
- `generate_agent_snapshots.js`; `.dmtools/runners/fa-*.json`
- `js/unit-tests/test_developTicketAndCreatePR.js` (`prompts/bash_tools.md > B7` suite, gh-775)

## Machine jobs
- [x] ▶ dev (fa-story-dev) · [run](https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/actions/runs/39033733321) · started 12:46 · done 13:14 ✅

name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Install dmtools CLI
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash
          echo "$HOME/.dmtools/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Run docs unit tests
        run: |
          dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_agentDocsCoverage.json

+## cli_execute_command — author-side executor rules (never teammate-facing)

+rejects `;`, `&&`, `||`, `|`, `>`, `<`, and substitution (backticks, `$(...)`,

  "fields": {
    "summary": "Remove dmtools executor bash rules from teammate prompts — keep only fa-sandbox-required bash guidance",
    "description": "## Goal — Teammate prompts carry zero dmtools-executor bash rules (v3.1, frame inverted; owner decisions folded in)

One sentence: **Every teammate-facing prompt (`prompts/*.md`, `instructions/**/*.md` composed via `*.json` cliPrompts) contains no `cli_execute_command` / metacharacter-executor rules at all; the bash guidance that survives is only what the teammate's own fa sandbox demonstrably requires; the executor constraints live in agent-authoring docs.**

## Retractions
- v1–v2 "split the rule block per surface, keep the CLI half in the prompt" — owner correction: the CLI half does not belong in teammate prompts in ANY form. `cli_execute_command` runs only inside dmtools JS actions in this repo (agent authoring), never in the teammate runtime; carrying its rules in prompts burns noise into every session of ~20 agents.
- v2 "add an allowance for chaining on the bash surface" — subsumed: with the executor block deleted, nothing in the prompt forbids chaining anymore; no new allowance text is needed.

## Facts pinned
- **Executor constraint is author-side only**: `cli_execute_command` / CliCommandExecutor rejects `; && || | > <` + substitution; quoting does NOT bypass (guard scans the whole string); compound logic goes through a script file. `js/common/setupCommands.js:24-32`, `js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:142-150`, `AGENTS.md:36` (dmtools global). Used only when writing agents — never by a teammate.
- **Teammate bash = fa-harness persistent shell.** Sandbox-observed errors that justify every surviving rule: trailing `exit` kills the session → `read_bash` fails `Invalid shell ID`; late `$?` reads the wrong command's code; `$PIPESTATUS` produced wrong exit codes; foreground sleep-poll pins the tool-call open (gh-775, B1–B7); cwd carry-over silently writes outputs into `dependencies/<repo>/` (C1–C8).
- **The leak**: `prompts/bash_tools.md:8-24` (SAFETY S1/S2 + FORBIDDEN + EXAMPLES) is pure executor guidance composed into ~20 agent JSONs; `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` is an orphan duplicate (`KNOWN_ORPHANS`, `js/unit-tests/test_instructionRefs.js:36`).
- Author-side docs already exist: `AGENTS.md` (dmtools globals), `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md`.

## Change
1. `prompts/bash_tools.md`: **delete** the SAFETY/FORBIDDEN/EXAMPLES block (lines 8–24). Keep B1–B7, C1–C8, and fold in the three orphan rules (no trailing `exit`, immediate `$?`, no `$PIPESTATUS`) — each justified by a sandbox error above. No dmtools-CLI-execution wording remains.
2. Delete `instructions/common/bash_tools.md`; drop its `KNOWN_ORPHANS` entry.
3. Re-home the executor rules for agent authors — single plain command, script-file wrapper, quoting-no-bypass, scan-whole-string — into `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` (owner-decided home; not `AGENTS.md`).
4. `prompts/story_solution_prompt.md:26` — the `&&` one-liner becomes legal by deletion; keep it, contradiction gone.
5. `instructions/common/dmtools_cli.md` unchanged (teammate invoking dmtools binaries for data is teammate work, not the executor).
6. Regenerate snapshots; update text-asserts; `js/` untouched.

## Acceptance criteria
- **AC1** — no teammate-facing md under `prompts/` or `instructions/` contains executor-rule strings ("metacharacter", `Chaining: ; && ||`, "One simple executable command at a time"). Hook: grep gate + text-assert.
- **AC2** — `prompts/bash_tools.md` keeps the B1–B7 chain verbatim (existing `B1 --> … --> B7` assert in `js/unit-tests/test_developTicketAndCreatePR.js` passes unchanged), keeps C1–C8, and now houses exit/`$?`/`$PIPESTATUS`.
- **AC3** — `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` deleted; `test_instructionRefs.js` green without the orphan entry.
- **AC4** — `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` contains the re-homed executor rules.
- **AC5** — no snapshot contains both a chaining-forbid string and a `&&` example (today `snapshots/story_solution.md:248/333` fails).
- **AC6** — `node generate_agent_snapshots.js` delta removes only the bash-tools FORBIDDEN/EXAMPLES section across snapshots; second run leaves a clean tree.
- **AC7** — `git diff --stat js/` empty for the implementing PR.

## Test plan
- `UT-P1` (AC1): text-assert — executor strings absent from `prompts/` + `instructions/`.
- `UT-P2` (AC2): existing B7 suite green; new asserts for exit/`$?`/`$PIPESTATUS` presence.
- `UT-P3` (AC3): `test_instructionRefs.js` green post-removal.
- `UT-P4` (AC4): SKILL.md contains the re-homed rules.
- `UT-P5` (AC5): snapshot contradiction scan.
- `IT-P1` (AC6): regeneration idempotent; delta scoped to the bash-tools sections.
- `E2E-P1`: one scratch dev-agent job on an `fa` runner — a chained `&&` command executes in the teammate shell; outputs delivery unaffected.
- `REG-P1` (AC2): sandbox rules survive verbatim (exit, `$?`, `$PIPESTATUS`, B1–B7, C1–C8). Merge rule: **red REG blocks merge even with all UT/IT/E2E green.**
- `REG-P2` (AC7): CI diff-guard that `js/` is unchanged.

## Edge cases
- **E1** — if the E2E probe shows the fa sandbox itself rejects some operator, the prompt stays SILENT (owner-decided): the finding is reported back to the owner, not encoded as a teammate prompt rule.
- **E2** — weak model re-added to the provider queue later: nothing to re-tighten prompt-side; iteration cost is governed by model choice, not prompt bans.
- **E3** — ticket-derived text: `sanitizeForShell` / title sanitization stay byte-identical (AC7).
- **E4** — chaining never overrides B1 background-first for long jobs.

## Non-goals
No `js/` or executor-guard changes; no changes to `dmtools_cli.md` data-fetch guidance; no per-agent prompt files; no model/provider names in prompts.

## Decisions (owner, 2026-10-17)
1. Executor-rules home: `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` — confirmed.
2. Probe-discovered operator rejections: the prompt stays silent — no rules added from probe findings.

blocks.text:
name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Install dmtools CLI
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash
          echo "$HOME/.dmtools/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Run docs unit tests
        run: |
          dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_agentDocsCoverage.json

+## cli_execute_command — author-side executor rules (never teammate-facing)
+
+`cli_execute_command` runs only inside dmtools JS actions in this repo (agent
+authoring) — never in the teammate runtime. Its executor (CliCommandExecutor)
+rejects `;`, `&&`, `||`, `|`, `>`, `<`, and substitution (backticks, `$(...)`,
+`${...}`) anywhere in the command string.
+
+Rules for author-side JS:
+
+- One simple executable command at a time.
+- Quoting does NOT bypass the guard — the scan covers the whole command string.
+- Compound logic goes through a script file: write the script, then run the
+  script as a single command.
+
+Enforced in `js/common/setupCommands.js`, `js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js`, and
+the dmtools global Copilot instructions. These rules must NOT be copied into
+teammate prompts (`prompts/`, `instructions/`) — teammate bash is the fa-harness
+persistent shell and follows only the fa-sandbox guidance in

  "key": "gh-967",
  "fields": {
    "summary": "Remove dmtools executor bash rules from teammate prompts — keep only fa-sandbox-required bash guidance",
    "description": "## Goal — Teammate prompts carry zero dmtools-executor bash rules (v3.1, frame inverted; owner decisions folded in)

One sentence: **Every teammate-facing prompt (`prompts/*.md`, `instructions/**/*.md` composed via `*.json` cliPrompts) contains no `cli_execute_command` / metacharacter-executor rules at all; the bash guidance that survives is only what the teammate's own fa sandbox demonstrably requires; the executor constraints live in agent-authoring docs.**

## Retractions
- v1–v2 "split the rule block per surface, keep the CLI half in the prompt" — owner correction: the CLI half does not belong in teammate prompts in ANY form. `cli_execute_command` runs only inside dmtools JS actions in this repo (agent authoring), never in the teammate runtime; carrying its rules in prompts burns noise into every session of ~20 agents.
- v2 "add an allowance for chaining on the bash surface" — subsumed: with the executor block deleted, nothing in the prompt forbids chaining anymore; no new allowance text is needed.

## Facts pinned
- **Executor constraint is author-side only**: `cli_execute_command` / CliCommandExecutor rejects `; && || | > <` + substitution; quoting does NOT bypass (guard scans the whole string); compound logic goes through a script file. `js/common/setupCommands.js:24-32`, `js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:142-150`, `AGENTS.md:36` (dmtools global). Used only when writing agents — never by a teammate.
- **Teammate bash = fa-harness persistent shell.** Sandbox-observed errors that justify every surviving rule: trailing `exit` kills the session → `read_bash` fails `Invalid shell ID`; late `$?` reads the wrong command's code; `$PIPESTATUS` produced wrong exit codes; foreground sleep-poll pins the tool-call open (gh-775, B1–B7); cwd carry-over silently writes outputs into `dependencies/<repo>/` (C1–C8).
- **The leak**: `prompts/bash_tools.md:8-24` (SAFETY S1/S2 + FORBIDDEN + EXAMPLES) is pure executor guidance composed into ~20 agent JSONs; `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` is an orphan duplicate (`KNOWN_ORPHANS`, `js/unit-tests/test_instructionRefs.js:36`).
- Author-side docs already exist: `AGENTS.md` (dmtools globals), `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md`.

## Change
1. `prompts/bash_tools.md`: **delete** the SAFETY/FORBIDDEN/EXAMPLES block (lines 8–24). Keep B1–B7, C1–C8, and fold in the three orphan rules (no trailing `exit`, immediate `$?`, no `$PIPESTATUS`) — each justified by a sandbox error above. No dmtools-CLI-execution wording remains.
2. Delete `instructions/common/bash_tools.md`; drop its `KNOWN_ORPHANS` entry.
3. Re-home the executor rules for agent authors — single plain command, script-file wrapper, quoting-no-bypass, scan-whole-string — into `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` (owner-decided home; not `AGENTS.md`).
4. `prompts/story_solution_prompt.md:26` — the `&&` one-liner becomes legal by deletion; keep it, contradiction gone.
5. `instructions/common/dmtools_cli.md` unchanged (teammate invoking dmtools binaries for data is teammate work, not the executor).
6. Regenerate snapshots; update text-asserts; `js/` untouched.

## Acceptance criteria
- **AC1** — no teammate-facing md under `prompts/` or `instructions/` contains executor-rule strings ("metacharacter", `Chaining: ; && ||`, "One simple executable command at a time"). Hook: grep gate + text-assert.
- **AC2** — `prompts/bash_tools.md` keeps the B1–B7 chain verbatim (existing `B1 --> … --> B7` assert in `js/unit-tests/test_developTicketAndCreatePR.js` passes unchanged), keeps C1–C8, and now houses exit/`$?`/`$PIPESTATUS`.
- **AC3** — `instructions/common/bash_tools.md` deleted; `test_instructionRefs.js` green without the orphan entry.
- **AC4** — `.github/skills/agent-prompt-architecture/SKILL.md` contains the re-homed executor rules.
- **AC5** — no snapshot contains both a chaining-forbid string and a `&&` example (today `snapshots/story_solution.md:248/333` fails).
- **AC6** — `node generate_agent_snapshots.js` delta removes only the bash-tools FORBIDDEN/EXAMPLES section across snapshots; second run leaves a clean tree.
- **AC7** — `git diff --stat js/` empty for the implementing PR.

## Test plan
- `UT-P1` (AC1): text-assert — executor strings absent from `prompts/` + `instructions/`.
- `UT-P2` (AC2): existing B7 suite green; new asserts for exit/`$?`/`$PIPESTATUS` presence.
- `UT-P3` (AC3): `test_instructionRefs.js` green post-removal.
- `UT-P4` (AC4): SKILL.md contains the re-homed rules.
- `UT-P5` (AC5): snapshot contradiction scan.
- `IT-P1` (AC6): regeneration idempotent; delta scoped to the bash-tools sections.
- `E2E-P1`: one scratch dev-agent job on an `fa` runner — a chained `&&` command executes in the teammate shell; outputs delivery unaffected.
- `REG-P1` (AC2): sandbox rules survive verbatim (exit, `$?`, `$PIPESTATUS`, B1–B7, C1–C8). Merge rule: **red REG blocks merge even with all UT/IT/E2E green.**
- `REG-P2` (AC7): CI diff-guard that `js/` is unchanged.

## Edge cases
- **E1** — if the E2E probe shows the fa sandbox itself rejects some operator, the prompt stays SILENT (owner-decided): the finding is reported back to the owner, not encoded as a teammate prompt rule.
- **E2** — weak model re-added to the provider queue later: nothing to re-tighten prompt-side; iteration cost is governed by model choice, not prompt bans.
- **E3** — ticket-derived text: `sanitizeForShell` / title sanitization stay byte-identical (AC7).
- **E4** — chaining never overrides B1 background-first for long jobs.

## Non-goals

name: Agent Docs

# Mandatory check for PRs that touch agent configs, JS actions, instructions,
# prompts or human docs:
#   1. Regenerates docs/agents/generated/* and fails when the committed docs
#      are stale (git diff non-empty).
#   2. Runs the docs unit tests (agentDocGenerator + docs coverage) via dmtools.

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'
      - '.github/workflows/agent-docs.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - '*.json'
      - 'js/**'
      - 'instructions/**'
      - 'prompts/**'
      - 'docs/agents/**'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  docs-freshness:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Regenerate agent docs
        run: node js/agentDocGenerator.js

      - name: Fail when generated docs are stale
        run: |
          if ! git diff --exit-code -- docs/agents/generated; then
            echo "::error::docs/agents/generated is stale. Run 'node js/agentDocGenerator.js' and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi

  docs-coverage-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Install dmtools CLI
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://github.com/epam/dm.ai/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash
          echo "$HOME/.dmtools/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Run docs unit tests
        run: |
          dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_agentDocsCoverage.json
